decks.notes: The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively disrupt the opponent's game plan by utilizing efficient removal spells like Terminate and Thoughtseize, while also applying pressure with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker. The deck aims to control the board with disruptive elements and then close out the game with powerful attacks. The inclusion of Seasoned Pyromancer and Feign Death adds some versatility to the deck, allowing for more options in disrupting the opponent's strategy and maintaining a steady stream of threats.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful planeswalkers and creatures to control the game, while also having a strong mana base to support its multicolor cards. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while generating value through cards like Wrenn and Six and Teferi, Time Raveler. The deck also includes removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending to deal with threats, as well as creatures like Solitude and Endurance for additional control. Leyline Binding and Boseiju, Who Endures provide protection and resilience. Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines and The One Ring offer powerful win conditions.

The main idea of this deck is to utilize Cascade cards to cast powerful spells for free, overwhelming the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. By using Cascade spells like Violent Outburst and Crashing Footfalls, the deck can quickly flood the board with creatures and apply pressure to the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Force of Negation and Bonecrusher Giant help to control the board and protect the player's game plan, making it difficult for the opponent to stop the cascade of threats.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using various cards to disrupt the opponent's strategy and establish board control. It utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Wrenn and Six, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Karn, the Great Creator, along with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The deck also aims to ramp up mana with Utopia Sprawl and acceleration spells, eventually casting big threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation and The One Ring. Additionally, it includes utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures to protect key spells and Delighted Halfling for card advantage.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief while utilizing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Orcish Bowmasters to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes cards that can provide additional value by returning creatures from the graveyard or copying spells. Additionally, it runs removal spells like Fatal Push and Terminate to deal with opposing threats. The overall strategy is to have a fast and disruptive start while maintaining a strong board presence to quickly defeat the opponent.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, while applying early pressure with powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker. The deck also features ways to recur creatures like persist and undying malice, allowing for a strong board presence even after removal. Cards like Terminate and Lightning Bolt provide removal options, while Magus of the Moon can disrupt opponents' mana bases. Overall, the deck aims to be fast, aggressive, and disruptive to overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay by utilizing cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Profane Tutor to quickly bring out high-impact creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Cragganwick Cremator. The key strategy involves using The Underworld Cookbook to discard cards like Yargle and Multani, allowing for explosive plays and overwhelming your opponent with powerful threats. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Lightning Bolt to control the game and ensure your key creatures can hit the board. The mana base is built to support this aggressive gameplan with efficient land choices and synergy with Urza's Saga.

The deck focuses on casting low-cost spells to cascade into higher-value spells like Crashing Footfalls, using cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst. It also includes disruptive elements like Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute to control the opponent's game plan. The deck is designed to quickly overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient threats like Questing Beast and Murktide Regent. Additionally, it includes versatile cards like Dead / Gone and Subtlety for removal and interaction. The mana base includes fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistency in casting spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful planeswalkers such as Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, along with the elemental powerhouse Omnath, Locus of Creation, to control the game and outvalue opponents. It also includes removal spells like Lightning Bolt, Prismatic Ending, Solitude, and Fury to deal with threats. The deck runs Leyline Binding to further disrupt opponents' strategies and has access to Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines for a game-ending threat. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's multicolor requirements.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly and aggressively disrupt your opponent's strategy while efficiently bringing out powerful creatures and controlling the board. With cards like Thoughtseize and Grief to disrupt your opponent's hand, along with strong removal spells like Terminate, the deck aims to keep the pressure on while deploying threats like Dauthi Voidwalker, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. Feign Death and Undying Malice provide ways to bring back key creatures and maintain aggression, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker helps to close out games quickly.

This deck focuses on aggressive early game plays with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also utilizes cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice to protect and recur key threats. The deck includes removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to control the board, as well as hand disruption with Thoughtseize. Blood Moon can also disrupt opponents relying on non-basic lands. Overall, the deck aims to apply constant pressure, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and close out games quickly.

The main concept of this Modern Aggro-Jund deck is to quickly disrupt and control the opponent's hand and board while also applying pressure with efficient and aggressive creatures. The deck utilizes powerful removal spells like Thoughtseize and Lightning Bolt, along with disruptive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck also includes card advantage engines like Wrenn and Six and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to maintain a strong board presence and outvalue the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to outpace and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of disruption and aggression.

This deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures to generate value through combo interactions and toolbox options. The key strategy involves using creature-based cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to search for and play key creatures like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide. With a mix of aggressive and utility creatures, along with sacrifice and card draw engines, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents by leveraging its versatile toolbox of creatures.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with various abilities to create powerful combos and gain advantage over the opponent. Cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide are key pieces in the toolbox, allowing for strong synergies and flexibility in gameplay. Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution provide additional utility in fetching specific creatures when needed. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its versatile creatures and combo potential, while also maintaining a solid mana base with various land options.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent through a combination of efficient burn spells and aggressive creatures. By maintaining a hyper-aggressive playstyle, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize and turn the game in their favor. The inclusion of powerful red burn spells like Lightning Bolt, Rift Bolt, and Lava Spike, alongside fast creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Guide, allows the deck to consistently apply pressure and close out games quickly. Additionally, cards like Roiling Vortex and Skullcrack prevent the opponent from gaining life or stabilizing, maintaining the deck's aggressive edge.

The main idea of this deck is to assemble UrzaTron (Urza's Tower, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Mine) as quickly as possible to generate large amounts of mana. This mana is then used to play powerful threats like Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger, and Wurmcoil Engine. The deck also includes control elements like Karn, the Great Creator, Oblivion Stone, and Relic of Progenitus to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck can utilize Expedition Map and Ancient Stirrings to find key pieces and ensure consistency in its game plan.
